summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Lista de Precios VENEGE. 41/41 pytest backend tests pass (auth, RBAC price columns, admin protection, search, history, refresh, admin sync). Frontend E2E flow via mobile viewport (390x844) passes: login for caracas and master, search 'bridgestone', product view with correctly scoped price tiles (caracas=4, master=19, Precio N badges, 2-decimal Bs/USD values), sticky action bar (Buscar otro / Nueva consulta), inventory modal, per-user recent history, master-only Panel de Administrador link, master panel sync + stats + global feed. Non-master users correctly cannot see the master link. Role-based column authorization is fully enforced server-side across all 5 non-master roles — direct SKU URL access returns ONLY the role's allowed columns. Passwords reject with Spanish message. All /api endpoints require Bearer token (401). All /api/admin endpoints correctly 403 for non-master roles.

issues: AppHeader component is rendered TWICE in master.tsx (lines 64 and 74) — one in loading branch, one in loaded branch. Only one is ever visible at a time so it is not user-facing, but it creates duplicate testID='header-logout' nodes intermittently and is a minor cleanup — extract header outside conditional.

action_items: Optional cleanup: in /app/frontend/app/(app)/master.tsx, hoist <AppHeader/> above the loading/loaded conditional so it is only rendered once (currently rendered on lines 64 and 74).
No functional bugs to fix — feature is production-quality for phase 1.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly separates authorized_columns() as the server-side source of truth — non-master roles CANNOT retrieve unauthorized price columns even via direct SKU URL tampering (verified against 6 test roles x 5 sample SKUs).
onedrive_service.py is properly isolated behind is_configured()/fetch_rows() so plugging real Graph credentials later needs no changes to auth/roles/search.
Search endpoint strips prices from response (verified) — never returns 'prices' key.
History uses two-step $pull+$push for correct dedupe-then-cap-6 semantics per user.
bcrypt password hashing + PyJWT with 12h expiry + user/role revalidation on every request via get_current_user() (defends against role tampering in JWT if user role changes).
seed_data_creation: None — used only the 6 pre-seeded users and the 46 mock products from build_mock_products(). Test history entries added to caracas / oriente_sur under normal API contract.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend BASE_URL: https://venege-precios.preview.emergentagent.com. Run tests with `cd /app/backend/tests && EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Users in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Frontend renders duplicate testID='header-logout' briefly during expo-router transitions — always target the VISIBLE one or navigate directly via router paths.
rca_of_issue: No critical issues found. The single flaky observation was a transient duplicate header-logout DOM element caused by expo-router keeping the previous screen mounted during transition; not a bug and does not affect users.
